name: Daraa protests
description: Protests over the arrest of boys for anti-Assad graffiti meet live fire, sparking a nationwide uprising.

name: Siege of Homs
description: Government forces besiege opposition districts of Homs for three years until rebels evacuate the old city.

name: Houla massacre
description: 108 villagers, nearly half of them children, are killed; UN investigators blamed pro-government forces.

name: Battle of Aleppo
description: Syria's largest city is split for four years until a siege and bombing campaign retakes its east for the government.

name: Ghouta chemical attack
description: Sarin rockets hit opposition-held Ghouta outside Damascus, killing hundreds; UN inspectors confirmed sarin use.

name: ISIS takes Raqqa
description: The Islamic State drives out other rebel groups and makes Raqqa the capital of its self-declared caliphate.

name: Siege of Kobani
description: Kurdish YPG fighters, backed by US-led airstrikes, hold Kobani against ISIS in a turning point against the group.

name: ISIS captures Palmyra
description: ISIS seizes Palmyra, carrying out mass executions and blowing up the ancient city's temples.

name: Russian intervention begins
description: Russian airstrikes from Hmeimim air base begin, turning the war in the government's favour.

name: Khan Shaykhun chemical attack
description: A sarin attack kills about 90 people; UN-OPCW investigators blamed the Syrian government, and the US strikes back.

name: Battle of Raqqa
description: The Kurdish-led SDF, backed by coalition airstrikes, takes Raqqa from ISIS, leaving much of the city destroyed.

name: Operation Olive Branch
description: Turkey and allied Syrian rebels take the Kurdish-held Afrin region, displacing much of its population.

name: Eastern Ghouta offensive
description: A month-long siege and bombardment retakes the last rebel enclave near Damascus, killing over 1,500 civilians.

name: Douma chemical attack
description: A chlorine attack kills dozens in Douma; the OPCW later attributed it to the Syrian air force.

name: Battle of Baghuz
description: The SDF takes Baghuz, the last village held by ISIS, ending its territorial caliphate.

name: Operation Peace Spring
description: After US troops pull back, Turkey invades the Kurdish-held northeast, taking Ras al-Ayn and Tal Abyad.

name: Northwest offensive
description: Government and Russian forces push into Idlib, displacing nearly a million people before a March ceasefire.

name: Opposition offensive on Aleppo
description: HTS-led rebels launch a surprise offensive from Idlib and take Aleppo within days, then sweep south.

name: Fall of the Assad government
description: Rebels enter Damascus as Bashar al-Assad flees to Russia, ending more than 50 years of his family's rule.
